verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Anytype that answers questions, summarizes, or drafts from your notes. What Anytype documents is an MCP server, a local API and an agents skill that let external AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) read and modify your Objects. Those are developer building blocks and external-tool integrations, not the product's own assistant. 'Queries' are criteria-based filtered views, not AI question answering.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a built-in AI assistant can answer questions, summarize, and draft grounded in my own notes — with clear controls over what data it sees
